motivation: Pilot post-training token masking confounds learned joint behavior with disablement distribution shift. Retrain each token policy from its own zero-initialized controller.
comparison: Local full-token vs ledger-only trained vs question-only trained, same architecture/data/optimizer/initialization/parameter count.
decision_rule: If question-only matched training achieves comparable joint current/initial/protected competence, changes to pre-question memory formation are not necessary for that observed competence on these tasks.
limits: All token policies use future-answer loss; no ground-truth dependency labels are supplied.
This separates temporal adaptation locations, not recurrent vs KV paths.
One initialization remains a pilot; no equivalence claim from failure to find a difference.
Evaluate first on the same development cases; any confirmatory extension must be locked separately.
